notes.title: Carrier - Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who's played and reviewed Carrier! We're glad you're enjoying it.

Patch 1.1 is a minor update based on some player feedback to improve experience across multiple machines.

- Added in-game settings menu (accessible using the wrench icon in the bottom left)

- Added resolution settings 

- Added full support for 3840 x 2160 4K resolutions

If you have any issues with 4K resolutions still, let us know in the comments or on the discussion forum.
